text:
Nations Championship: Will Joseph retains England place vs New Zealand's All Blacks as Henry Pollock dropped amid nine changes
Steve Borthwick makes nine changes to England XV for visit of All Blacks in Nations Championship on Saturday (2.10pm); Fin Smith, George Furbank, Tommy Freeman, Seb Atkinson, Jamie George, Fin Baxter, Joe Heyes, Ollie Chessum, Ben Curry all return; Will Joseph keeps place on wing
Thursday 19 November 2026 14:00, UK
Will Joseph has retained his place on the wing for England's Nations Championship Test against New Zealand on Saturday, with Fin Smith among those restored and Henry Pollock dropped to the bench.
Joseph, who missed out on a place in England's matchday 23 for their 45-22 defeat of Australia a fortnight ago, started in last week's crushing 78-15 success over Japan, scoring five tries.
The 24-year-old picked up just his second Test cap in that victory at Twickenham, and his first since July 2022 under Eddie Jones. He moves from right to left wing for the visit of the All Blacks.
Elsewhere fly-half Smith, full-back George Furbank, wing Tommy Freeman, centre Seb Atkinson, hooker Jamie George, props Fin Baxter and Joe Heyes and back-rowers Ollie Chessum and Ben Curry all return as part of nine changes by Steve Borthwick.
Pollock, who made just his second Test start for England in 15 caps last week, drops down to the replacements bench.
Outside-centre Henry Slade, scrum-half Jack van Poortvliet, lock and captain Maro Itoje, second-row Alex Coles - who shifts back alongside Itoje from blindside flanker - and No 8 Ben Earl keep their places.
Alongside Pollock, the replacements bench is made up of hooker Luke Cowan-Dickie, loosehead Ellis Genge, tighthead Will Stuart, lock George Martin, back-row Greg Fisilau, scrum-half Ben Spencer and fly-half/full-back Marcus Smith.
"There are few bigger occasions in international rugby than facing New Zealand," said Borthwick.
"It's a fixture that always carries a special significance, and one that the players are hugely looking forward to.
"We know the quality New Zealand have in their team. We've prepared for the very best version of them, knowing the challenge they will bring and the level we'll need to reach to get the result we want."
England squad to face New Zealand in Nations Championship
England: 15 George Furbank, 14 Tommy Freeman, 13 Henry Slade, 12 Seb Atkinson, 11 Will Joseph, 10 Fin Smith, 9 Jack van Poortvliet; 1 Fin Baxter, 2 Jamie George, 3 Joe Heyes, 4 Maro Itoje, 5 Alex Coles, 6 Ollie Chessum, 7 Ben Curry, 8 Ben Earl.
Replacements: 16 Luke Cowan-Dickie, 17 Ellis Genge, 18 Will Stuart, 19 George Martin, 20 Greg Fisilau, 21 Henry Pollock, 22 Ben Spencer, 23 Marcus Smith.
All Blacks make eight changes for England clash
For the All Blacks, they have brought Codie Taylor back as captain and veteran Beauden Barrett is set to win his 150th cap as coach Dave Rennie makes eight changes.
Rennie has considerably strengthened the side after their upset loss to Wales last weekend, which left them one point ahead of South Africa in the Southern Hemisphere standings.
Taylor, who takes over from Barrett as skipper, is one of two changes in the front row for Saturday's clash. He replaces Asafo Aumua at hooker, and prop Ethan de Groot regains his berth at loosehead in place of George Bower.
Fabian Holland takes over from Josh Lord among the locks, while Tupou Vaa'i comes back for Anton Segner in the back row.
Damian McKenzie returns at fly-half and Cam Roigard at scrum-half, with last week's half-back pairing of Richie Mo'unga and Cortez Ratima dropping to the bench.
Jordie Barrett and Will Jordan return from injury among the backs, while centre Anton Lienert-Brown will earn his 100th cap.
New Zealand: 15 Beauden Barrett, 14 Will Jordan, 13 Anton Lienert-Brown, 12 Jordie Barrett, 11 Josh Moorby, 10 Damian McKenzie, 9 Cam Roigard; 1 Ethan de Groot, 2 Codie Taylor, 3 Fletcher Newell, 4 Scott Barrett, 5 Fabian Holland, 6 Tupou Vaa'i, 7 Peter Lakai, 8 Wallace Sititi.
Replacements: 16 Asafo Aumua, 17 George Bower, 18 Pasilio Tosi, 19 Anton Segner, 20 Leicester Fainga'anuku, 21 Cortez Ratima, 22 Richie Mo'unga, 23 Rieko Ioane.
digest_he:
מאמן נבחרת אנגליה ברוגבי, סטיב בורטוויק, ביצע תשעה שינויים בהרכב הפותח לקראת משחק הבית מול הנבחרת הלאומית של ניו זילנד באליפות האומות. השינויים מגיעים בעקבות הניצחון המוחץ של אנגליה על יפן, שבו הצטיין השחקן הצעיר וויל ג'וסף בן ה-24, ששמר על מקומו בכנף השמאלית לאחר שכבש חמישה טאצ'דאונס בשבוע שעבר.

בין השחקנים שחוזרים להרכב הפותח נמנים הקוורטרבק פין סמית', המגן ג'ורג' פורבנק וג'יימי ג'ורג', בעוד שהשחקן הנרי פולוק ירד לספסל המחליפים. מנגד, נבחרת ניו זילנד ערכה גם היא שמונה שינויים בהרכב תחת המאמן דייב רני, לאחר ההפסד המפתיע לוולס בשבוע שעבר, וכללה בחזרה את הקפטן קודי טיילור ואת השחקן הוותיק באודן בארט שיערוך את הופעתו ה-150 במדים הלאומיים.
